candidate_ideas.statement: The balanced tetragonal splitting F=O_{P^1}(4)⊕O_{P^1}(5) controls the geometric bottleneck for the exact lowest-weight contribution on M_{6,6}.
The six-point evaluation-failure locus is cut out by O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}, derived from the f_2=5 summand of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 including the sign in γ^*O(-5).
The proposed evaluation-failure locus Z is nonempty by the indicated Riemann-Roch computation for (g,n)=(6,6).
Ordered distinct reduced divisors form a finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open in the relative linear system (that open is not closed).
The exact codimension-13 contribution supported on Z is of pure Tate type Q(8).
The tetragonal contribution on Z assembles into the exact lowest-weight target W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)≅⊕Q(8).
Stratification of the relative degree-six linear system by h^0(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}) yields the component, dimension, stabilizer, and finite-cover data needed for the Tate-type argument.

established_facts.statement: The exact target identity is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6}) = W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6})(21).

The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is asserted to be a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
For d=3g-3+n, the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), identified by Poincare duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d).

For the forgetful map M_{6,6}→M_{6,5}, the q=0 term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; with fibre cohomology only in q=0,1, no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.
H^0(C,ω_C⊗W^∨|_C(Γ))=H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_{f_1}^∨|_C(Γ))⊕H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_{f_2}^∨|_C(Γ)), and the required vanishing holds if 0>deg(ω_C⊗W_{f_i}^∨|_C(Γ))=2g-2-(4g+12-4f_i)+n=4f_i+n-2g-14.

established_facts.statement: With the packet degree formula deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f, one has deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6 for g=6.
CE convention: W_5:=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C is the f_2=5 summand of (O(2)⊗γ^*F^∨)|_C and is not the O_{P^1}(5) summand of F.

established_facts.evidence: FND-0035 [corroborated; RED-0001 residual list; coefficients Q]
established_facts.statement: For the RED-0001 residual list over Q, the required ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd for (g,n)∈{(3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,2)} and equals vcd-1 for (8,0),(8,1); it never exceeds vcd, so vanishing-above-vcd proves none of these seven cases.
For n≤c(g), one has ∗(M_{g,n})=R∗(M_{g,n}) by the cited comparison theorems in the primary locator excerpt.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Construct and identify the evaluation-failure locus Z for the f_2=5 summand (C66-GEO-Z).
Stratify the relative degree-six linear system by h^0(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}) (C66-GEO-H0; depends on Z).
Determine components, dimensions, stabilizers, and finite-cover behavior of the stratified locus (C66-GEO-COMP; depends on Z and the h^0 stratification).
Prove Tate type for the exact codimension-13 contribution supported on Z (C66-TATE-SUPPORT; depends on component data).
Assemble the tetragonal contribution into the exact lowest-weight target W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) (C66-TATE-ASSEMBLY; depends on Tate support).
Compute determinantal rank-drop ideals and fibre dimensions on Z (C66-COMP-RANK).
Test proposed component decompositions of the h^0 stratification (C66-COMP-COMP).
Independently confirm nonemptiness of Z via the Riemann-Roch computation for (g,n)=(6,6).
